desc: Ten uploads from the past three months drop off at different points. Compare their retention curves and judge where viewers leave and whether video length explains it.
Two titles ran as an A/B test on last week's upload. Given the impressions and click-through rate for each, decide which title did better and whether the gap is larger than noise.
Draft the opening 30 seconds of the script for the next upload. The first sentence has to give the viewer a reason to keep watching.
Write the monthly community post about how the channel did in August. Quote only the figures provided and do not recompute any of them.
The raw footage of the interview episode is full of filler words and long pauses. Cut them out and align the caption timings to the trimmed audio.
Three takes were shot for the same segment back in March. Stitch them into one clip and put fades at the transitions.
